description: Canonical territory tree. Ids are NUTS-2024 codes as used by BDNS regiones (ES, ES1, ES11, ES111), 'WORLD' for BDNS 'XXXX - TODO EL MUNDO', and 'mun:<INE 5-digit>' for the 313 Galician municipalities (INE relación de municipios a 1-1-2026). Containment follows parent links: mun:15030 ⊂ ES111 ⊂ ES11 ⊂ ES1 ⊂ ES ⊂ WORLD. Note: NUTS2 ids are the comunidades autónomas; NUTS3 are provinces except Baleares and Canarias (islands), where INE province code is shared.
